name: testssl
label: testssl.sh
description: testssl.sh: which TLS/SSL protocols and cipher categories the server offers, its certificate, and known TLS flaws. An https:// url (SNI from its host) or a TCP port. Tests one address of the host.
contacts: TLS handshakes with {target} at one address of its host (system resolver only): protocols, ciphers, certificate, and probes for TLS flaws (Heartbleed, CCS, Ticketbleed, ROBOT, renegotiation, CRIME, POODLE, SWEET32, FREAK, DROWN, LOGJAM, BEAST, LUCKY13, RC4), one GET for BREACH; no other host
